gold.user: As a conference administrator, I want to retrieve a list of all recordings for a specific conference so that I can review the content and manage the recordings effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of recordings, including details such as the recording SID, duration, date created, and status.

gold.user: As a conference moderator, I need to update the metadata of a specific recording to correct the title and add notes for future reference.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with updated fields and return the updated recording details, confirming the changes were successful.

gold.user: As a user, I want to fetch the details of a specific recording from a conference so that I can listen to it or download it for my records.
gold.ideal: The API should return the recording details, including the URL for playback, duration, and any associated metadata.

gold.user: As a conference administrator, I want to delete a specific recording that is no longer needed to keep the storage organized and free up space.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the recording and return a success message, ensuring that the recording is no longer accessible.
